description: This Java class 'PersonnelSheetPopulator' is responsible for populating a staff personnel sheet within an Excel workbook, associating staff members with their respective offices. It manages mappings between offices and personnel, creates and formats the sheet, and writes staff details into it.

classes.name: PersonnelSheetPopulator
classes.description: Class responsible for populating an Excel sheet with personnel data associated with various offices, formatting the sheet, and maintaining mappings between offices and their respective staff members.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the workbook sheet with staff data organized by office.

methods.name: populateStaffByOfficeName
methods.description: Helper method that writes office and staff details into the sheet.

methods.name: setOfficeToPersonnelMap
methods.description: Builds the map linking office names to lists of staff members.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a StaffData object to the map under the specified office key.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Configures the column widths and header row of the sheet.

methods.name: getOfficeNameToBeginEndIndexesOfStaff
methods.description: Getter for the map containing begin and end indexes of staff lists per office.
